title.sw: Funga chaneli kwa nguvu na utazame kufuli la muda

starter.cli:
CHAN=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=chan lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
POINT=$(lncli listchannels | jq -r --arg c "$CHAN" '.channels[] | select(.remote_pubkey==$c) | .channel_point' | head -1)
lncli closechannel --force --chan_point "$POINT"
bitcoin-cli -generate 1
sleep 3
lncli pendingchannels | jq '.pending_force_closing_channels[] | {blocks_til_maturity, limbo_balance}'

solution.cli:
CHAN=$(JIFUNZE_NODE=chan lightning-cli getinfo | jq -r .id)
POINT=$(lncli listchannels | jq -r --arg c "$CHAN" '.channels[] | select(.remote_pubkey==$c) | .channel_point' | head -1)
lncli closechannel --force --chan_point "$POINT"
bitcoin-cli -generate 1
sleep 5
lncli pendingchannels | jq '.pending_force_closing_channels[] | {blocks_til_maturity, limbo_balance}'
